text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Did it! Lived up to model student name!
Great・Baku・shin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back, Trainer! Come! 
Praise to your heart's content!
choice_data_list: Now that was an exemplary run!
Not quite yet! We've still got more to win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flawless victory is very essence 
of class president!
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you next time, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! Leave all to exemplary model student, 
Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Direct course to next victory! 
Bakushiiiii―n!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Already so confident in next win?!
choice_data_list: I meant you shouldn't get so cocky……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Uoooh! 
Failing expectations would disgrace 
model student name!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Through fire or water! 
Will Bakushin straight to victory!

Misunderstood intent, 
but fired up Sakura Bakushin O regardless.
